abstract.p: Disclosed are compositions comprising HCFO-1233xf and at least one additional compound selected from the group consisting of HCFO-1232xd, HCFC-253fb, ethylene, HFC-23, CFC-13, HFC-143a, HFC-152a, HFC-236fa, HCO-1130, HCO-1130a, HCFC-244db, HFC-245fa, HFC-245cb, HCFC-133a, HCFC-254fb, HCFC-1131, HCFO-1242zf, HCFC-226ba, and HFC-227ca. Compositions comprising HCFO-1233xf are useful to make HCFC-244bb, and/or HFO-1234yf by fluorination.
